title: Free Falling
excerpt: I wish I could free fall during a Los Angeles sunset
body:
I wish I could free fall during a Los Angeles sunset
Pushed out and down
From atmospheric heights
Passing through
Blue
Red
Orange
Pink
Past all the clouds
All the trees
Headed straight towards steel
And sun-bleached concrete
With no desire to die
But more a longing to see
To appreciate all that’s in front of me
